sentiment.label: neutral
sentiment.reason_it: Il sentiment di mercato è neutrale oggi, con un indice VIX in aumento al 17.25 (+5.18%) e S&P 500 che guadagna l'1.08%. Il DXY stabile intorno a 100.90 (+0.05%) e il prezzo del petrolio in calo (-0.83%) contribuiscono a una visione cauta. Gli articoli odierni, come quelli del Financial Times e di Crisis Group, trattano temi geopolitici e macroeconomici senza segnalare particolari cambiamenti nel sentiment.
sentiment.reason_en: Market sentiment is neutral today, with the VIX index rising to 17.25 (+5.18%) and S&P 500 gaining 1.08%. The stable DXY around 100.90 (+0.05%) and decreasing oil prices (-0.83%) contribute to a cautious view. Today's articles from Financial Times and Crisis Group discuss geopolitical and macroeconomic themes without indicating significant changes in sentiment.

market_impact_summary.it: Il mercato azionario mostra un recupero con S&P 500 +1.08% e STOXX 600 +0.22%. Il VIX sale al 17.25, segnalando una maggiore volatilità. Il TLT bond USA 20Y guadagna lo 0.49%, mentre il rendimento del decennale USA scende al 4.45%. L'oro è stabile intorno ai $4226.00/oz. Gli analisti di BlackRock e Goldman Sachs continuano a monitorare l'evoluzione geopolitica e macroeconomica.
market_impact_summary.en: The stock market shows a recovery with S&P 500 +1.08% and STOXX 600 +0.22%. The VIX rises to 17.25, indicating increased volatility. The TLT bond USA 20Y gains 0.49%, while the US 10Y yield decreases to 4.45%. Gold is stable around $4226.00/oz. BlackRock and Goldman Sachs analysts continue to monitor geopolitical and macroeconomic developments.

audio_script_it:
Buongiorno, benvenuti al Morning Briefing di Price Alert.

Il Nikkei ha chiuso in rialzo dell'1.55%, Shanghai in rialzo dell'1.78%. Questo suggerisce un'apertura positiva per i mercati europei.

nella seduta precedente, l'S&P 500 ha chiuso in rialzo dell'1.08%, il VIX è salito del 5.18%. Il Dollar Index è in rialzo dello 0.05% a 100.9 L'oro è pressoché invariato a $4226/oz. Il petrolio Brent è in calo dello 0.83% a $79.19 Il rendimento del decennale USA è in calo dello 0.27% al 4.45%.

La situazione tra USA e Iran resta tesa, con possibili implicazioni per i prezzi del petrolio. La crisi potrebbe inoltre influenzare i piani di spesa per la difesa e la sicurezza a livello globale.

Nessun dato macro rilevante in uscita oggi.

Passiamo ora al comparto degli asset digitali. Bitcoin si mantiene sopra i sessantaquattromila dollari, con una variazione pressoché invariata del -0,02%. Gli ETF su Bitcoin hanno registrato deflussi significativi, con un outflow di 90,7 milioni di dollari. Questo movimento potrebbe essere influenzato dalle tensioni geopolitiche e dalle dichiarazioni dei rappresentanti della Federal Reserve. 
  Tra le altcoin, Ethereum guadagna l'1,42% a duemila settecentoquarantanove dollari, mentre Solana sale dello 0,56% a settantatre virgola ottantacinque dollari e BNB aumenta dello 0,84% a cinquecentonovantatre virgola trentotto dollari. 
  Il Fear & Greed Index è a 20, in zona di Extreme Fear, il che suggerisce cautela sugli investitori.

Nessun dato macro in agenda oggi. Per approfondire i temi di oggi, sulla nostra piattaforma trovate gli articoli completi nella sezione Storie in Primo Piano. Grazie per l'attenzione e a domani.
audio_script_en: Good morning, welcome to the Price Alert Morning Briefing. The Nikkei closed up 1.55%, Shanghai up 1.78%. This suggests a positive opening for European markets. In the previous session, the S&P 500 closed up 1.08%, the VIX rose 5.18%. The Dollar Index is up 0.05% at 100.9 Gold is essentially flat at $4226/oz. Brent crude oil is down 0.83% at $79.19 The 10-year US yield is down 0.27% at 4.45%. The situation between the US and Iran remains tense, with possible implications for oil prices. The crisis could also affect global defense and security spending plans. No major macroeconomic data releases today. Let's pivot to the cryptocurrency markets... Bitcoin holds above sixty-four thousand dollars, with a nearly unchanged variation of -0.02%. Bitcoin ETFs have seen significant outflows, with a $90.7 million outflow. This movement could be influenced by geopolitical tensions and statements from Federal Reserve representatives. Among altcoins, Ethereum gains 1.42% at $2749, while Solana rises 0.56% at $73.85 and BNB increases 0.84% at $593.38 The Fear & Greed Index is at 20, in Extreme Fear territory, suggesting investor caution. No macroeconomic data on the agenda today. For a deeper dive into today's topics, find the full articles in the Top Stories section on our platform. Thanks for your attention, and we'll see you tomorrow.

articles.title: Geopolitics and global value chains: Implications for trade policy and development in Asia
articles.snippet: Rising geopolitical tensions and increasing fragmentation introduce new risks into global production networks, forcing both disruptions and creating new strategic opportunities. How is US trade policy shaping these tensions and how are developing Asia-Pacific participants responding to them? This session provides an overview of how the content of global supply chains have been reshaped by US protectionism, how developing countries can engage and upgrade, and the turbulence expected over the coming year. articles.title: Cracks are showing in Trump’s blue-collar base | Steven Greenhouse
articles.snippet: Voters are upset that Trump has failed to deliver on his economic promises. That’s bad news for Republicans in November If any demographic group was key to Donald Trump’s election victories in 2016 and 2024, it was white, blue-collar voters. But in perhaps perilous news for Republicans, Trump’s support from that group has plummeted – as many white, working-class voters have grown upset about everything from increased inflation and gas prices to Trump’s war against Iran. These glaring cracks in Trump’s blue-collar base point to big trouble for Republicans in this November’s midterm elections. In 2024, Trump won 66% of white voters without a college degree, but a new CBS News poll found that 54% of that demographic disapprove of his performance. articles.title: India’s Imports of Russian Oil Set for New Record High
articles.snippet: India is set to import a record-high volume of Russian crude in June as the Hormuz crisis and the U.S. waivers on Russia’s barrels have pushed the world’s third-largest crude importer to gorge on Moscow’s oil again. India has imported 2.6 million barrels per day (bpd) of Russian crude oil so far in June, according to preliminary vessel-tracking data from commodity analytics firm Kpler cited by Indian media. So far this month, Russian crude has accounted for as much as 53.5% of all Indian oil imports, per the data. …
